# Acme UI

A small draft kit for trying layouts: calm surfaces, one accent, 8px grid.

## Consuming

Namespace `Acme`. Load `tokens.css`, `components/bundle.css`, then `components/bundle.js`.

- Button — The main way to act on a page: submits a form or starts a flow.
- Link — Text that leads to another page or place; it navigates, it does not act.
